_note: SAMPLE DATA ONLY. Every ability below is marked "sample": true and was
written to exercise the card layout and phase sorting, not transcribed from
the published rules. Rules text is paraphrased and values may be wrong.
Replace these with the real text from your book/app, then drop the
"sample" flag so the banner in the UI disappears.
Sections that are empty are known gaps, not bugs. Run `npm run validate:data`
after editing to catch schema mistakes.
name: Soulblight Gravelords

factionAbilities.name: Deathless Minions
factionAbilities.effect: This unit has WARD (6+) while it is wholly within 12" of any friendly SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS HERO.

factionAbilities.name: The Hunger

timing.reaction: You declared a Fight ability for this unit and it destroyed any enemy models

factionAbilities.declare: Pick a friendly SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS unit that has fought this phase.

abilities.name: Swift and Deadly
abilities.declare: Pick up to 2 friendly SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS units that have not been deployed.
abilities.effect: Those units are placed to one side and are considered to be in ambush. At the end of any turn, you can set them up anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: The Unquiet Dead
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS SUMMONABLE unit that is not in combat.
abilities.effect: Return up to 3 slain models to that unit.

heroicTraits.name: Terrifying Visage
heroicTraits.declare: Pick an enemy unit within 12" of this unit that has declared a Charge ability.
heroicTraits.effect: Subtract 1 from that unit's charge roll.

artefactsOfPower.name: Ring of Domination
artefactsOfPower.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of the bearer.
artefactsOfPower.effect: Until the start of your next turn, that unit cannot use commands and subtract 1 from hit rolls for its attacks. This is a long deliberately verbose effect used to check that cards with a lot of text still lay out sensibly, do not clip their container, and do not break across a printed page in an awkward place.

abilities.name: Amaranthine Orb
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this WIZARD.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice for each model in that unit that is within range. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on that unit.

abilities.name: Summon Chalice of Ushoran
abilities.declare: Pick a point on the battlefield within 12" of this WIZARD.
abilities.effect: Set up a CHALICE OF USHORAN manifestation wholly within 12" of this WIZARD and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Supernatural Strength
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly SUMMONABLE unit wholly within 12" of this unit.
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of that unit's melee weapons until the end of the phase.

abilities.name: Dragged Down and Torn Apart
abilities.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for this unit's attacks if it has 10 or more models.

abilities.name: Slavering Charge
abilities.effect: This unit can run and still use Charge abilities later in the turn.

abilities.name: Vigour Mortis
abilities.declare: Pick this unit if it is the target of a shooting attack.
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for that attack if this unit has 10 or more models.
